pattern.name: Plate-Pulse-Plexus Universal Cranial Nerve Architecture
pattern.frontend_language: triune neurovascular coherence system — plate / pulse / plexus
pattern.core_principle: Every cranial nerve (and every spinal nerve root) operates as a triune coherence system. When any layer decoheres, the whole triad collapses = neurovascular decoupling (Thorpe's term) = loss of EZ-pulse synchrony.

triad_definitions.PLATE: REZ / dural sleeve — the transition field where central and peripheral coherence meet (Schwann ↔ oligodendroglia / astrocyte / macroglia). EZ lattice + myelin transition zone. Mechanically and energetically fragile.
triad_definitions.PULSE: Vascular / energetic driver — rhythmic arterial pulsation that must stay harmonically coupled. Desynchronised by Liver Yang rising (excess high-frequency low-coherence excitation from global metabolic overdrive).
triad_definitions.PLEXUS: Autonomic or fascia-based amplifier — distributes coherence to tissue; receives mixed signals when central and peripheral compartments are out of synchrony. Ganglion + autonomic fibres + perivascular fascia.
